decision: What should the copy and structure of a new /compare page be (Unica vs school, tutor programs, learning centres, online learning platforms)?

options.bet: Explicit headline listing all four options, a five-column at-a-glance table, then one block per option (good at / harder / with Unica), FAQ and the free assessment
options.benefit: Fair to each option, so the comparison reads as honest
options.cost: Long page; five columns need a phone switch
options.risk: Online platforms look strong on price and adapting
